meta.title: OpenLawn real screen UI testing (Ralph loop)
meta.scope: Exercise OpenLawn's real browser UI via computerUse; fix regressions until each scenario passes with screenshot proof.
non_goals: Production Firebase data mutation outside the test company
assumptions: npm run dev serves the app on port 9002
Test accounts exist for manager, employee, and pending user

tasks.title: Auth — sign-in
tasks.description: Auth form loads; valid credentials reach the app; invalid credentials show an error state.
acceptance: Sign-in form is visible at app URL when logged out
Valid manager or employee login navigates into the authenticated shell
Invalid credentials show a visible error (toast or inline), not a blank page

tasks.title: Auth — sign-up / pending approval
tasks.description: Sign-up flow lands on pending-approval UI for new employees needing approval.
acceptance: Sign-up tab/form is usable
Completing signup as a role that requires approval shows PendingApprovalScreen (or equivalent)
No uncaught UI crash during signup

tasks.title: Manager shell
tasks.description: Manager/admin landing view shows header, map, and Customers/Employees/Crews management chrome.
acceptance: Header renders with role-appropriate controls
Map region is present (tiles or map container visible)
Customers / Employees / Crews views are reachable
No blank crash after login as manager

tasks.title: Add / edit customer
tasks.description: Customer add and edit sheets open, accept input, save, and reflect in list/map.
acceptance: Add customer sheet opens from manager UI
Required fields can be filled and submitted
New or edited customer appears in the customer list (or map selection)
Sheet dismisses without trapping focus

tasks.title: Add / edit employee
tasks.description: Employee add and edit sheets open, accept input, save, and reflect in the employee list.
acceptance: Add employee sheet opens from manager UI
Employee can be created or edited and saved
Employee list updates after save
Sheet dismisses cleanly

tasks.title: Crew sheet
tasks.description: Create/edit crew and assign members via AddCrewSheet.
acceptance: Crew create/edit sheet opens
Members can be selected/assigned
Save succeeds and crew appears in crews view
No stuck loading or silent failure

tasks.title: Route display
tasks.description: Routes generate/display with map markers and crew popup interaction.
acceptance: Route display area shows route content or empty state (not a crash)
Selecting a crew/route opens CrewPopup or equivalent detail
Map markers or route overlays render when routes exist

tasks.title: Employee view
tasks.description: Employee login shows EmployeeRouteView, not manager management chrome.
acceptance: Signed-in employee sees employee route experience
Manager-only tabs/sheets (add customer/employee/crew) are not primary chrome
Assigned route/customer content loads or shows a clear empty state

tasks.title: Profile / schedule / company sheets
tasks.description: Profile, schedule, and company sheets open, allow interaction, and dismiss.
acceptance: Profile sheet opens and closes
Schedule sheet opens and closes
Company settings or company management opens for roles that have access
No focus trap preventing return to main UI

tasks.title: Pending users (manager)
tasks.description: Manager pending-users sheet lists pending accounts; approve/reject if wired.
acceptance: Manager can open PendingUsersSheet
Pending users list renders (or clear empty state)
If approve/reject controls exist, they are clickable and produce visible feedback

tasks.title: Service photos
tasks.description: Photo capture/gallery UI opens; upload affordance works or fails with a clear error.
acceptance: ServicePhotoManager (or photo capture/gallery) is reachable from a service/customer context
Capture or file picker affordance is present when canEdit
Gallery or empty state renders without crash

tasks.title: Mobile swipe / layout
tasks.description: At mobile viewport, manager navigation is usable without overflow/clipping that blocks core actions.
acceptance: At 390x844, primary navigation or swipe between views works
Core CTAs (add/open sheets) remain reachable
No horizontal page overflow that hides the main map or list

tasks.title: Sign-out
tasks.description: Sign-out returns to auth; authenticated content is no longer accessible.
acceptance: Sign-out control is reachable from header/profile
After sign-out, AuthForm (or login) is shown
Refreshing does not restore the previous authenticated shell without credentials
